orderVersionConflict.title: Order updated
orderVersionConflict.message: The order was updated by another operation. Refresh the latest state before trying again.

conflict.title: State changed
conflict.message: The current state no longer matches this operation. Review the latest state.

validation.title: Check your input
validation.message: Some fields failed validation. Correct them before submitting again.

badRequest.title: Invalid request
badRequest.message: The request contains invalid parameters or an unsupported format.

unauthorized.title: Sign in required
unauthorized.message: Your session has expired or the credentials are incorrect. Sign in again.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.message: Your account does not have permission to perform this operation.

notFound.title: Record not found
notFound.message: This record does not exist or is no longer available. Refresh the list to check.

rejected.title: Operation rejected
rejected.message: The current conditions do not meet the requirements for this operation.

internal.title: Service unavailable
internal.message: The service could not complete the request. Keep the trace ID for support.

adminNotInitialized.title: Administrator not initialized
adminNotInitialized.message: Contact an administrator to initialize the system before signing in.

admissionBlocked.title: Admission blocked
admissionBlocked.message: This release is not eligible for Shadow creation. Review the admission results.

admissionStale.title: Admission facts changed
admissionStale.message: The admission facts have changed. Reload the preview and confirm again.

admissionGuard.title: Admission guard unavailable
admissionGuard.message: A verified identity has not been bound. This operation is unavailable.

reviewConflict.title: Review updated
reviewConflict.message: Another operation updated this review. Refresh it before confirming again.

idempotencyConflict.title: Operation identity conflict
idempotencyConflict.message: This operation identifier was used for different content. Refresh and review the existing result.

network.title: Connection failed
network.message: The service could not be reached. The operation outcome may be unconfirmed.

unknown.title: Request failed
unknown.message: The request could not be completed. Keep the trace ID and contact support.

actions.refresh: Refresh the latest state and confirm again. The operation will not be replayed automatically.
actions.correct: Check your input and the operation requirements before confirming again.
actions.contact: Contact your administrator or support and provide the trace ID.
actions.checkConnection: Check your connection and the latest state. Confirm the outcome before deciding whether to retry.
